verdict: Complete SEC event populations, verified FINRA positive-presence evidence and archived Nasdaq Trader directory states materially improve the free historical universe evidence. Sparse archive states, ticker reuse and missing permanent identity still prevent a complete survivorship-safe 2009-2024 security universe, continuous listing intervals, terminal sessions and delisting returns.
requiredUniverseContract: Every then-listed U.S. common-equity security, including later delisted/acquired/failed securities
Stable security-level identity across ticker, class, exchange, merger and reorganization changes
Effective first/final trading sessions and point-in-time listing state
Corporate actions, successor links and delisting/terminal-return treatment
Exact as-of availability and immutable source provenance

newFinraEvidence.availabilityRule: Each row is usable only at or after its resolved archive knownAt; backdating is rejected.
newFinraEvidence.volumeQuarantine: No volume value was parsed, aggregated or admitted as an outcome.
newFinraEvidence.allowedInference: Positive symbol presence at the named FINRA facility on the observed trade date only.
newFinraEvidence.forbiddenInference: No absence, continuous listing, permanent identity, total-market coverage, OHLCV or return may be inferred.

allowedInference: Positive security presence, observed symbol, security name and source exchange code at each captured directory state only.
forbiddenInference: No absence, continuity, permanent identity, exact first/final session, OHLCV, return or delisting return may be inferred.
blockingReasons: Issuer CIK identifies a registrant, not a permanent traded security or share class.
Direct SEC CIK-ticker-exchange snapshots start in 2017 and are states rather than effective intervals.
The four FINRA states improve 2016/2021 population evidence but cannot fill unobserved intervals or supply permanent identifiers.
MIDAS has market-presence descriptors but no CIK continuity, OHLCV, actions or terminal returns.
The current-ticker price cohort is survivorship-prone and systematically omits many delisted/acquired securities.
Form 8-A/EFFECT/Form 25/15 cannot independently establish all first/final trading sessions or successor identity.
No cost-free lawful panel satisfying the full population, identity, action, timestamp and delisting-return contract was found.
The exact final input has not passed a genuinely independent external audit.
Forty-one positive FINRA snapshots are sparse activity observations, not a complete population or interval ledger.
Five empty ADF anchors are not interpreted as security absence.
Archived Nasdaq directory states are sparse positive observations and do not prove unobserved intervals.
Symbols and symbol-name pairs are not permanent security identifiers; observed name variation demonstrates unresolved reuse or change risk.
The directories contain no adjusted OHLCV, terminal-session proof or delisting returns.
freeFallback: Use SEC, FINRA and archived Nasdaq directory rows as source-bound nullable states; retain every unobserved interval and identity transition as unknown and restrict historical claims to explicitly observed populations.
whatWouldChangeDecision: A lawful zero-cost security-level 2009-2024 master with stable identity, exchange-effective listing intervals, corporate actions, terminal sessions and delisting returns must pass independent audit.
